name: Chanel
desc: Privately owned luxury house selling haute couture, ready-to-wear, leather goods, fragrance, beauty, fine jewellery and watches through its own boutiques worldwide.
products: Fashion, leather goods, fragrance and beauty, fine jewellery, watches
marketing_autonomy_basis: Group parent itself; no outside parent
stores_or_sites: 500+ boutiques per Wikipedia infobox (body text says around 310 Chanel S.A. boutiques)
markets: Europe, Americas, Asia-Pacific (China, Japan, Korea), Middle East through directly operated boutiques

signals.what: Marie-Laure Cérède (ex-Cartier) appointed head of jewellery and watchmaking

fit_rationale: Chanel's watch and fine-jewellery push under a new director, and its top-client events model, fit Paddock Club and Monaco/Abu Dhabi hospitality; luxury fashion partners LVMH and Gucci set the category bar.
category_conflict: potential: LVMH (F1 global partner, Louis Vuitton), Gucci (Alpine from 2027), TAG Heuer and several watch brands
f1_markets: United Kingdom, France-adjacent Monaco, Italy, United States, Japan, China, Singapore, UAE, Saudi Arabia

access.roles: Global CEO; President Fashion; President Watches & Fine Jewellery; Chief Brand Officer

outstanding: Confirm that no Williams Racing association remains (Williams partner page opened 2026-11-27 does not list Chanel); boutique count inconsistent on Wikipedia

name: Skechers
desc: California footwear and apparel maker, taken private by 3G Capital in 2025, selling comfort, lifestyle and performance shoes worldwide.
products: Lifestyle, performance and work footwear; apparel
marketing_autonomy_basis: Standalone operating company owned by 3G Capital
markets: United States, Europe, India, China and global distributor markets

signals.what: Take-private by 3G Capital announced May 2025, completed Sep 2025

fit_rationale: Already in motorsport via W Racing Team and Valentino Rossi and a heavy Super Bowl advertiser; new 3G ownership could fund a global F1 consumer play against Puma and adidas.
category_conflict: potential: Puma, adidas (team footwear and apparel partners)
f1_markets: United States, India-adjacent Asia, Europe, China, Brazil, Mexico

access.roles: CEO; Chief Marketing Officer; Head of Sports Marketing

compliance: Patent suit by Kizik (2025); proposed class action over spam emails (2026); none serious
outstanding: Deal value of take-private; marketing head

name: Tory Burch
desc: Founder-controlled New York fashion house selling ready-to-wear, handbags, footwear and accessories through about 400 own stores and 3,000 wholesale doors.
marketing_autonomy_basis: Independent private company controlled by founder
stores_or_sites: About 400 Tory Burch stores (2026); 3,000+ wholesale doors
markets: United States, Europe (London, Paris, Rome), China, Japan, Korea

alt_indicators.evidence: Deloitte Global Powers of Luxury Goods 2023 ranks it no. 37 with est. USD 1.75bn luxury sales FY2022

fit_rationale: US-founded brand with flagships in Shanghai, Tokyo and Seoul; F1's growing US female fanbase (Miami, Austin, Las Vegas) suits Tory Burch's core women's accessories customer.
category_conflict: potential: Tommy Hilfiger (Cadillac), Gucci (Alpine from 2027), Louis Vuitton (F1)
f1_markets: United States, United Kingdom, Italy, Japan, China

access.roles: CEO; Chief Marketing Officer; Executive Chairman (founder)

outstanding: Current revenue (Deloitte figure is FY2022 estimate); minority investors after 2018

name: Omega
desc: Swatch Group's flagship Swiss watch brand, Olympic official timekeeper since 1932, maker of the Speedmaster and Seamaster lines.
marketing_autonomy_basis: Brand-level marketing visible (ambassadors, Olympic timing) but group decides
markets: Worldwide boutiques and retailers; Europe, China, US, Japan

alt_indicators.evidence: Morgan Stanley x LuxeConsult: est. CHF 2.2bn revenue 2025, about 460,000 pieces
Olympic official timekeeper since 1932, continuing to at least 2032; PGA of America and Omega European Masters

signals.what: Speedmaster X-33 worn by Artemis II crew

fit_rationale: Omega fell behind Audemars Piguet in 2025 sales (Morgan Stanley); a team timing or official-watch deal would answer TAG Heuer and Rolex-owned Tudor directly in the motorsport audience.
category_conflict: potential: TAG Heuer (F1 official timekeeper), IWC, Breitling, Richard Mille, Tudor, Girard-Perregaux, H. Moser
f1_markets: All Grand Prix markets; strongest China, US, Europe, Japan

access.roles: Omega President and CEO; Swatch Group Extended Group Management; Head of Sports Marketing

outstanding: Swatch Group disputes Morgan Stanley estimates; brand-level revenue not published

name: Marc O'Polo
desc: Bavarian premium casualwear brand run by the Böck family, selling men's, women's and denim collections through own stores and wholesale internationally.
marketing_autonomy_basis: Independent company led by Maximilian Böck
fit_rationale: Premium German casualwear brand with a strong DACH retail base; team licensing or a Silverstone-style lifestyle tie could lift international awareness beyond its home market.
category_conflict: potential: Tommy Hilfiger, BOSS, Pepe Jeans (team apparel)
f1_markets: Austria, Netherlands, Belgium, Italy, Spain, Hungary

access.roles: CEO; Chief Brand Officer; Head of Marketing

outstanding: Current ownership statement (page cites Böck acquisitions only); latest revenue; store count; who the Deloitte FY2022 figure refers to

name: Zadig & Voltaire
desc: Paris contemporary fashion brand founded by Thierry Gillier, with about 430 shops worldwide and a fragrance line, held through ZV Holding.
marketing_autonomy_basis: Founder-run; artistic director is the founder
markets: France, Europe, US, Asia; partner shops in Middle East and South America

alt_indicators.evidence: Deloitte Top 100 no. 87, est. USD 389m FY2022
430 shops end-2022, company-operated shops in 15 countries on 3 continents

fit_rationale: Rock-inspired Paris label with a strong youth image; a capsule with a team could reach F1's younger, female Drive to Survive audience in Europe and the US.
category_conflict: potential: team apparel partners (Tommy Hilfiger, Pepe Jeans, Castore, Puma)
f1_markets: France-adjacent Monaco, Belgium, Spain, Italy, United States, Middle East

access.roles: Managing Director; Head of Marketing and Communications

outstanding: Shareholders not stated on page; current revenue; employees 500-999 per 2023 data
